easy: A big group of countries from around the world that work together to keep peace.

ex.en: Almost every country in the world is a member of the UN.
ex.ko: 세계의 거의 모든 나라가 유엔 회원국이다.

easy: Drinks like beer and wine that only grown-ups drink, which can make people dizzy.

ex.en: Kids should never drink alcohol.
ex.ko: 아이들은 절대 술을 마시면 안 된다.

easy: A clear liquid that dries fast and is used for cleaning and in medicine.

ex.en: The nurse cleaned my scraped knee with alcohol.
ex.ko: 간호사 선생님이 까진 무릎을 알코올로 닦아 주셨다.

easy: A card that shows who you are, often with your photo on it.

ex.en: Dad showed his ID at the airport.
ex.ko: 아빠는 공항에서 신분증을 보여 주셨다.

easy: Having to do with Jewish people, their culture, or their religion.

ex.en: Our neighbors invited us to celebrate Hanukkah, a Jewish holiday.
ex.ko: 이웃이 유대교 명절인 하누카를 함께 지내자고 우리를 초대했다.

easy: A thing made to blow up with a loud bang and break things.

ex.en: Workers found an old bomb from a past war, and experts safely took it away.
ex.ko: 일꾼들이 옛날 전쟁 때의 폭탄을 발견했고, 전문가들이 안전하게 치웠다.

easy: Money or gifts given to a church or temple.

ex.en: We put a dollar in the offering plate at church.
ex.ko: 우리는 교회에서 헌금 접시에 1달러를 넣었다.

easy: Carrying a weapon, like a gun.

ex.en: Armed guards stood outside the bank.
ex.ko: 무장한 경비원들이 은행 밖에 서 있었다.

easy: A boy or man that someone loves and dates.

ex.en: My big sister's boyfriend helped us carry the Christmas tree.
ex.ko: 언니의 남자 친구가 크리스마스트리 옮기는 걸 도와줬다.

easy: Going toward a certain place or direction.

ex.en: The school bus was headed north.
ex.ko: 스쿨버스는 북쪽으로 향하고 있었다.

easy: The holy book of Christians.

ex.en: Grandma reads the Bible every morning.
ex.ko: 할머니는 매일 아침 성경을 읽으신다.

easy: A member of the Democratic Party, one of the two big political parties in the US.

ex.en: My aunt is a Democrat and votes in every election.
ex.ko: 이모는 민주당원이고 선거 때마다 투표하신다.

easy: Slow to learn or understand.

ex.en: I felt dumb when I forgot my own phone number.
ex.ko: 내 전화번호를 까먹었을 때 내가 참 멍청하게 느껴졌다.

easy: Not able to speak for a moment, usually because of surprise.

ex.en: We were struck dumb when we saw the giant whale.
ex.ko: 거대한 고래를 보고 우리는 말문이 막혔다.

easy: Having to do with the Soviet Union, a big country that included Russia until 1991.

ex.en: The Soviet Union sent the first person into space.
ex.ko: 소련은 처음으로 사람을 우주에 보냈다.

easy: Having to do with treating and watching real patients.

ex.en: Doctors tested the new medicine in clinical trials.
ex.ko: 의사들은 임상 시험에서 새 약을 시험했다.

easy: A person who works in a mill, grinding grain into flour.

ex.en: The miller ground the wheat into soft white flour.
ex.ko: 방앗간 주인이 밀을 갈아 부드러운 하얀 밀가루를 만들었다.

easy: To make a place free of something you do not want.

ex.en: We need to rid the kitchen of ants.
ex.ko: 우리는 부엌에서 개미를 없애야 한다.

easy: True or used everywhere in the world, by everyone.

ex.en: A smile is a universal sign of happiness.
ex.ko: 미소는 세계 어디서나 통하는 행복의 표시다.

easy: A person who belongs to the Jewish people or follows the Jewish religion.

ex.en: Sarah's family are Jews who celebrate Passover every spring.
ex.ko: 사라의 가족은 유대인이라서 봄마다 유월절을 지낸다.

easy: A long, deep, booming sound, like thunder.

ex.en: We heard the rolling of thunder far away.
ex.ko: 멀리서 우르릉거리는 천둥소리가 들렸다.

easy: The top boss of a company.

ex.en: The CEO of the toy company visited our school fair.
ex.ko: 장난감 회사의 최고 경영자가 우리 학교 축제에 왔다.

easy: To fail completely.

ex.en: Our class garden plan foundered when nobody brought seeds.
ex.ko: 아무도 씨앗을 가져오지 않아서 우리 반 텃밭 계획은 무산되었다.

easy: To fill with water and sink.

ex.en: The old fishing boat foundered in the storm.
ex.ko: 낡은 고깃배가 폭풍 속에서 침몰했다.

easy: Side by side.

ex.en: The two boats were tied up alongside.
ex.ko: 두 배가 나란히 묶여 있었다.

easy: Before any money is taken out for taxes or costs.

ex.en: The gross amount from our bake sale was fifty dollars.
ex.ko: 빵 바자회의 총수입은 50달러였다.

easy: Twelve dozen, which is 144.

ex.en: The school ordered a gross of pencils.
ex.ko: 학교에서 연필을 144자루 주문했다.

easy: To earn a certain amount of money before costs are taken out.

ex.en: The movie grossed a million dollars in one day.
ex.ko: 그 영화는 하루에 백만 달러의 총수입을 올렸다.

easy: A group in the US government that looks into serious crimes.

ex.en: The FBI helps catch people who break big laws.
ex.ko: FBI는 큰 법을 어긴 사람들을 잡는 일을 돕는다.

easy: A smartphone made by the company Apple.

ex.en: Mom used her iPhone to take a picture of us.
ex.ko: 엄마는 아이폰으로 우리 사진을 찍으셨다.

easy: Belonging to an art style from about 200 years ago that cared most about feelings and nature.

ex.en: We read a romantic poem about wild mountains and storms.
ex.ko: 우리는 거친 산과 폭풍에 관한 낭만주의 시를 읽었다.

easy: Showing love, like between two people who are dating.

ex.en: Dad made a romantic dinner with candles for Mom.
ex.ko: 아빠는 엄마를 위해 촛불을 켠 낭만적인 저녁을 차리셨다.

easy: A person who dreams about love and beautiful things.

ex.en: Grandpa is a romantic who still writes Grandma love letters.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 아직도 할머니께 연애편지를 쓰시는 낭만적인 분이다.

easy: Doing something for someone else, in their place.

ex.en: I accepted the prize on behalf of my whole class.
ex.ko: 나는 우리 반 전체를 대표해서 상을 받았다.

easy: A religion that believes in one God and follows the teachings of Muhammad in the Quran.

ex.en: Islam is one of the biggest religions in the world.
ex.ko: 이슬람교는 세계에서 가장 큰 종교 중 하나다.

easy: Very silly; not sensible at all.

ex.en: Jumping off the roof with an umbrella is an insane idea!
ex.ko: 우산을 들고 지붕에서 뛰어내리는 건 말도 안 되는 생각이야!

easy: Made of chemicals that have carbon in them, like the ones in living things.

ex.en: Sugar and fat are organic compounds.
ex.ko: 설탕과 지방은 유기 화합물이다.

easy: Coming from living things like plants and animals.

ex.en: Fallen leaves and other organic matter slowly turn into soil.
ex.ko: 낙엽과 다른 생물 찌꺼기는 천천히 흙으로 변한다.

easy: A person whose family comes from Arabia and who speaks Arabic, often living in the Middle East or North Africa.

ex.en: Many Arabs live in Egypt and Saudi Arabia.
ex.ko: 많은 아랍인이 이집트와 사우디아라비아에 산다.

easy: A fast, beautiful riding horse first raised in Arabia.

ex.en: The white Arab galloped across the sand.
ex.ko: 하얀 아라비아 말이 모래 위를 달려갔다.

easy: A loan from a bank to buy a house, paid back over many years.

ex.en: My parents pay the mortgage on our house every month.
ex.ko: 부모님은 매달 우리 집 대출금을 갚으신다.

easy: To promise your house or land to a bank so it will lend you money.

ex.en: The farmer mortgaged his farm to buy a new tractor.
ex.ko: 농부는 새 트랙터를 사려고 농장을 저당 잡혔다.

easy: Said to be true, but not proven yet.

ex.en: The alleged thief said he had only borrowed the bike.
ex.ko: 도둑으로 의심받는 사람은 자전거를 빌렸을 뿐이라고 말했다.

easy: Supposed to be something, but you doubt it.

ex.en: My brother's alleged magic trick was just hiding a coin in his sleeve.
ex.ko: 형의 이른바 마술은 그냥 소매에 동전을 숨기는 거였다.

easy: Something wrong that breaks a religious rule.

ex.en: Lying is a sin in many religions.
ex.ko: 많은 종교에서 거짓말은 죄다.

easy: To do something wrong that breaks a religious or moral rule.

ex.en: The story tells of a king who sinned and later said sorry.
ex.ko: 그 이야기는 죄를 지었다가 나중에 뉘우친 왕에 관한 것이다.

easy: A weapon with a long, sharp metal blade and a handle.

ex.en: The pirate waved his shiny sword.
ex.ko: 해적이 번쩍이는 칼을 휘둘렀다.

easy: A shiny round disc that holds music or computer files.

ex.en: Grandpa still plays his old CDs in the car.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 아직도 차에서 옛날 CD를 트신다.

easy: Being ready to start things on your own without being told.

ex.en: She showed initiative by cleaning the classroom before anyone asked.
ex.ko: 그녀는 누가 시키기도 전에 교실을 청소해서 주도성을 보여 주었다.

easy: The first move that starts something.

ex.en: Our class took the initiative to start a recycling club.
ex.ko: 우리 반이 앞장서서 재활용 동아리를 만들었다.

easy: A strong cotton cloth, usually blue, used to make pants and jackets.

ex.en: My jacket is made of blue jean.
ex.ko: 내 재킷은 파란 데님으로 만들어졌다.

easy: Looking very carefully and deeply, trying to find the truth.

ex.en: Mom gave me a searching look when I said the dog ate my homework.
ex.ko: 개가 숙제를 먹었다고 하자 엄마는 나를 꿰뚫어 보듯 쳐다보셨다.

easy: To tease someone in a friendly, joking way.

ex.en: My uncle loves to josh me about my messy hair.
ex.ko: 삼촌은 내 헝클어진 머리를 가지고 놀리는 걸 좋아하신다.

easy: Short for 'representative': a person who speaks or acts for a group or company.

ex.en: Our class rep shared our ideas with the principal.
ex.ko: 우리 반 대표가 교장 선생님께 우리 의견을 전했다.

easy: A person who uses violence and fear to try to get what they want.

ex.en: The police stopped the terrorists before anyone got hurt.
ex.ko: 경찰은 아무도 다치기 전에 테러범들을 막았다.

easy: Used for the first time, or never touched before.
ko: 처음 쓰는, 사람 손이 닿지 않은

ex.en: We skied on virgin snow that nobody had touched.
ex.ko: 우리는 아무도 밟지 않은 눈 위에서 스키를 탔다.

easy: Short for August, the month after July.

ex.en: School starts on Aug. 20 this year.
ex.ko: 올해는 8월 20일에 개학한다.

easy: Having to do with a group of people who share the same culture, language, or background.

ex.en: Our town has an ethnic food festival with dishes from many countries.
ex.ko: 우리 동네에서는 여러 나라 음식이 나오는 민족 음식 축제가 열린다.

easy: A group of airplanes owned by the same company.

ex.en: The airline has a fleet of 100 planes.
ex.ko: 그 항공사는 비행기 100대를 가지고 있다.

easy: A group of cars, buses, or trucks owned by the same company.

ex.en: Our school district owns a fleet of yellow buses.
ex.ko: 우리 교육구는 노란 버스를 여러 대 가지고 있다.

easy: Very fast.

ex.en: The fleet deer ran into the forest.
ex.ko: 날랜 사슴이 숲속으로 달려 들어갔다.

easy: The time when a baby is growing inside its mother's body.

ex.en: During her pregnancy, Aunt Jen ate lots of fruit.
ex.ko: 젠 이모는 임신 기간에 과일을 많이 드셨다.

easy: A small bird from Europe with a reddish-orange chest.

ex.en: A robin sat on the garden fence in England.
ex.ko: 영국의 한 정원 울타리에 울새 한 마리가 앉아 있었다.

easy: A North American bird with a reddish-orange chest that often hops on lawns in spring.

ex.en: A robin pulled a worm out of the wet grass.
ex.ko: 울새가 젖은 풀밭에서 지렁이를 끄집어냈다.

easy: The act of sending a message or signal from one place to another.

ex.en: The radio transmission from the astronauts was very clear.
ex.ko: 우주 비행사들이 보낸 무전은 아주 또렷했다.

easy: Having to do with communism, a system where the government owns the farms and factories.

ex.en: China is ruled by a communist party.
ex.ko: 중국은 공산당이 다스린다.

easy: A person who believes in communism.

ex.en: Karl Marx was a famous communist thinker.
ex.ko: 카를 마르크스는 유명한 공산주의 사상가였다.

easy: Almost the same as the real thing in every way.

ex.en: The game ended in a virtual tie.
ex.ko: 그 경기는 사실상 무승부로 끝났다.

easy: Planned or set up ahead of time.

ex.en: We met at the arranged time in front of the library.
ex.ko: 우리는 약속한 시간에 도서관 앞에서 만났다.

easy: A building where weapons are kept.

ex.en: The old arsenal is now a museum.
ex.ko: 그 오래된 무기고는 지금 박물관이 되었다.

easy: A famous golden award given each year for the best movies and actors.

ex.en: The actress cried when she won an Oscar.
ex.ko: 그 여배우는 오스카상을 받았을 때 울었다.

easy: A bowl you sit on to pee or poop, and then flush with water.

ex.en: Please flush the toilet when you're done.
ex.ko: 다 쓰면 변기 물을 내려 주세요.

easy: Flour made by grinding the whole wheat grain.

ex.en: Mom bakes bread with graham instead of white flour.
ex.ko: 엄마는 흰 밀가루 대신 통밀가루로 빵을 구우신다.

easy: Permission from a company to sell its products or run its kind of shop in one area.

ex.en: Mr. Park bought a franchise to open a pizza shop.
ex.ko: 박 씨 아저씨는 피자 가게를 열려고 가맹권을 샀다.

easy: A shop that sells a big company's products using that company's name.

ex.en: There is a burger franchise next to our school.
ex.ko: 우리 학교 옆에 햄버거 체인점이 있다.

easy: A soldier whose job is to be a police officer in the army.

ex.en: An MP checked our car at the army base gate.
ex.ko: 헌병이 군부대 정문에서 우리 차를 검사했다.

easy: To trust that someone or something will help you.

ex.en: You can rely on our dog to wake you up for breakfast.
ex.ko: 아침 먹을 때 깨워 주는 건 우리 강아지를 믿어도 돼.

easy: Short for southeast, the direction between south and east.

ex.en: The wind is blowing from the SE today.
ex.ko: 오늘은 남동쪽에서 바람이 분다.

easy: To be right next to something, touching at the edge.

ex.en: Our backyard butts up against the school field.
ex.ko: 우리 집 뒷마당은 학교 운동장과 맞닿아 있다.

easy: The country of Greece long ago, with cities like Athens and Sparta.

ex.en: The first Olympic Games were held in Greece long ago.
ex.ko: 최초의 올림픽 경기는 아주 옛날 그리스에서 열렸다.

easy: Having to do with the Nazis, the cruel group led by Hitler that ruled Germany from 1933 to 1945.

ex.en: Anne Frank hid from Nazi soldiers during the war.
ex.ko: 안네 프랑크는 전쟁 중에 나치 군인들을 피해 숨어 지냈다.

easy: A member of Adolf Hitler's political party in Germany.

ex.en: The Nazis started World War II in Europe.
ex.ko: 나치는 유럽에서 제2차 세계 대전을 일으켰다.

easy: How strong a mixture is, or how much of one thing is in it.

ex.en: Seawater has a high concentration of salt.
ex.ko: 바닷물은 소금 농도가 높다.

easy: Many things crowded close together in one place.

ex.en: There is a large concentration of birds near the lake.
ex.ko: 호수 근처에 새들이 많이 모여 있다.

easy: Extremely funny.

ex.en: The clown's hilarious act made everyone laugh.
ex.ko: 광대의 아주 웃긴 공연에 모두가 웃었다.

easy: The way something works or gets done.

ex.en: Voting is the mechanism our class uses to choose a leader.
ex.ko: 투표는 우리 반이 반장을 뽑는 방법이다.

easy: Badly damaged or destroyed.

ex.en: The rain left my drawing ruined.
ex.ko: 비 때문에 내 그림이 망가졌다.
